basis: User-confirmed external Claude feedback; F formula approved before native measurement
latency_scope: median of three stable per-run quantiles; individual repeats and scatter retained
F_formula: max(Go median * 1.10, Go median + 0.2 ms), ceil to 0.001 ms
capacity_scope: highest measured mixed-workload rate with latency/correctness/coverage in each repeat; ratio to Go report-only
cpu_profiling_trigger: any native non-overload stage repeat > Go three-run median * 1.5
steady_rss_also: <= Go same-stage three-run median, each native repeat
recovery_definition: after actual overload, finish five consecutive healthy one-second bins within 10s; FD return <= pre-overload + 2, bounded resources; query-in-flight observation limitations explicit
F_definition: 100 QPS, globally unique names, A70/AAAA30, forced foreign DoH via SOCKS5, mock80ms; continued unique tail is not overload recovery
